text:
Asha (CS): FYI—we've confirmed an index corruption during an embeddings reindex job that affected vector lookups for a subset of onboarding accounts between 2026-03-19 02:11 UTC and 02:38 UTC. Sending proactive updates.
Tom (Dev): Confirmed. Root cause is a race when rolling reindex + autoscaling; some shards wrote incomplete vectors. We're rebuilding affected indexes now.
Priya (SE): How many accounts? any high-risk renewals?
Asha (CS): ~23 accounts impacted, 6 in active onboarding, 2 flagged for upcoming renewals in next 30d. Risk: possible feature demos failing.
Liam (CS Manager): We need a short customer-facing statement + targeted follow-ups for the 8 high-touch accounts. Draft below.
Asha (CS): DRAFT OUTBOUND:

----
Subject: Incident update — temporary embeddings degradation and remediation

Hi <CustomerName>,

We want to update you about a brief issue we identified with our embeddings index on March 19th. Between 02:11–02:38 UTC some recent ingestion/reindex jobs produced incomplete vector entries for a subset of accounts which could lead to degraded search/retrieval quality or 5xxs for embedding-based endpoints.

What happened
• A reindex job and autoscale event overlapped, causing partial writes for certain shards.
• Impact window: 02:11–02:38 UTC
• Affected: 23 accounts (we've identified them and listed them in the internal doc)

What we're doing
• Rebuilding impacted indexes with snapshot-verified vectors (in progress).
• Applying a safeguard to pause reindex during autoscale events (hotfix deployed).
• Monitoring for post-rebuild regressions and rolling back if anomalies detected.

Customer impact & mitigations
• If you saw degraded results or errors, re-run the failed calls once rebuild completes; no data loss expected.
• For customers in onboarding, your onboarding engineer will run a validation sweep and re-ingest any failed items on your behalf.

Next steps & timeline
• Rebuild ETA: 6–12 hours from now (in progress)
• Follow-up email when rebuild completes + verification link

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. If you'd like a private bridge or demo validation, reply and we'll schedule it within 24h.

Best,
The Redwood Customer Success Team
----

Priya (SE): Suggest adding an explicit remediation play: we will snapshot current index -> run test queries -> reingest only missing vectors. Also add contact for escalation.
Asha (CS): Updated draft with remediation play and escalation contact.
Marta (Support): I'll queue the 6 onboarding accounts for manual validation once rebuild completes. Need list of affected object ids.
Tom (Dev): I'll paste a query to export affected ids: ```SELECT id FROM vector_index WHERE checksum=NULL AND last_write >= '2026-03-19T02:11:00Z' AND last_write <= '2026-03-19T02:38:00Z';``` Use with caution.
Liam (CS Manager): For renewal risk accounts: offer one month of waived overage + free onboarding assistance. Approve?
Asha (CS): +1 from me.
Priya (SE): +1
Marta (Support): +1
OpsBot: Incident update posted to #incidents: 1937654310. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1937654310
Asha (CS): Action items:
• Asha: send outbound to all 23 affected by EOD (use draft)
• Marta: manual validation queue for 6 onboarding accounts
• Priya: reach out to 2 renewal accounts with offer + schedule 1:1
• Tom: finish rebuild and confirm verification link
• Liam: prepare renewal credit template

Asha (CS): anything else? otherwise I will schedule the send in 30m.
Priya (SE): please blind-cc the account execs.
Liam (CS Manager): go ahead.
Tom (Dev): rebuild at 02:45 UTC started, ETA 9h.
Asha (CS): sending now. Will post updates here.
